title: Highlight candidates for an event
description: clips/work/<event>/highlights.json. Candidate fields (id, start_seg, end_seg, start_quote, end_quote, score, hook, reason, needs_visuals) are written by the highlight-selection skill's agent step. The cut and chosen fields are written by clips.py's snap/preview/choose subcommands, not by the agent. Run `clips.py status` for a human-readable view.

source_transcript.description: Path to the transcript this file was built from, relative to the repo root, e.g. clips/work/<event>/transcript.json.

burn.description: Options remembered across clips.py burn runs for this event.

crop.description: W:H:X:Y in source pixels for the whole event, set by `clips.py burn --crop ...` without --ids and reused when --crop is omitted.

clips.description: Crops for single clips, keyed by candidate id, set by `clips.py burn --ids ... --crop ...`. A clip listed here ignores the event crop: for when the speaker stands somewhere else, as in a Q&A.

start_seg.description: Index of the first segment of the clip (transcript.json segments[].i).

end_seg.description: Index of the last segment of the clip (inclusive).

start_quote.description: Exact text of the first segment (start_seg), used as a checksum against the transcript.

end_quote.description: Exact text of the last segment (end_seg), used as a checksum against the transcript.

hook.description: One line, in Italian, that would open the clip on socials.

reason.description: English: why this candidate works as a clip.

needs_visuals.description: True if the clip depends on the slides being readable to make sense.

chosen.description: Set by the choose subcommand. True if a human picked this candidate to be cut.

cut.description: Written by clips.py's snap/preview/choose subcommands, not by the agent.

segs.description: [start_seg, end_seg] this cut was computed from. snap keeps manual_shift only while this span is unchanged.

start_snapped.description: True if start was snapped to a detected silence edge.

end_snapped.description: True if end was snapped to a detected silence edge.

manual_shift.description: Human adjustment of each edge in seconds, relative to the snapped cut (set through choose --start/--end, cleared through choose --reset).

preview.description: Written by the preview subcommand. origin is the source time of the preview file's first frame.
